subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: Should maintainers require a live v2026.6.11 or current-main packaged-gateway reproduction before authorizing a fix for the reported 600-700 character tool cutoff and Skill Workshop proposal lookup failure?
rationale: The obvious source caps are much higher than the report, and the remaining plausible causes span display sanitization, provider serialization, prompt projection, transcript/session state, and workspace-scoped proposal lookup.

options.title: Require Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open and block automated repair until a packaged Linux gateway run captures the exact truncation and proposal-state failure with transcript and workspace evidence.

options.title: Investigate Source Paths Now
options.body: Assign a maintainer to trace display, provider, embedded-runner, and Skill Workshop state flows from source immediately, accepting higher risk of chasing the wrong layer.

options.title: Split By Symptom
options.body: Route read-output clipping to the older read-output thread and keep this issue focused on Skill Workshop state loss, at the cost of possibly splitting a shared root cause.

recommendation.title: Require Live Repro First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and block automated repair until a packaged Linux gateway run captures the exact truncation and proposal-state failure with transcript and workspace evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has recent merged work on both Skill Workshop proposal routing and fresh tool-result preservation, making them the best available owner among the inspected history signals.
